gloss: loss of contact; being out of touch

definitions.gloss: loss of contact; being out of touch; no communication
definitions.explanation: A state in which someone cannot be reached and no news or communication comes from them. Used when contact with a person has been completely lost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{音信不通|おんしんふつう}になった。
examples.english: I lost contact with my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だ。
examples.english: I've been out of touch with him since graduation.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だった⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: My brother, whom I hadn't heard from in ten years, suddenly got in touch.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) meaning complete loss of contact with someone.

COMPOUND: ⟦{音信|おんしん}→音信：24082_onshin⟧ (news/correspondence) + {不通|ふつう} (not going through)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音信不通|おんしんふつう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to lose contact
- {音信不通|おんしんふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま: still out of touch
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だった: had been out of touch for years
- {音信不通|おんしんふつう}だった⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to hear from someone who had been out of touch

USAGE:
Can describe both intentional disappearance (someone cuts off contact) and unintentional loss of contact (drifting apart). Often used in the pattern ～⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧{音信不通|おんしんふつう}だ (have been out of touch since ~).

In modern Japanese, also used casually for someone who stops responding to messages or calls.
